profile.headline: IT Rotational Development Associate - Software Developer @ Ascensus

positions.title: IT Rotational Associate - Web Developer
positions.description:
Integrated partner branding through Coldfusiuon and C# changes to existing project and deployed through Octopus and TeamCity.

Introduced new feature flags through SQL commands and added functionality integrating NGINX, IIS and ColdFusion.

Resolved bug in PRO by tracing issues through Elastic logging and SQL event logs, gracefully catching server errors

positions.title: IT Rotational Associate - Software Engineering in Testing
positions.description:
Co-directed shifting the entire automation testing framework to an object-oriented paradigm from a functional paradigm by introducing custom controls, resulting in improved maintainability.

Created and maintained nightly automation CI/CD flow with TeamCity and TFS for 205 test cases.

Automated over 30 manual test cases for iOS and Android using Selenium and Appium in C#, verified their runs using BrowserStack App Automate and a local emulator.

positions.title: IT Rotational Associate - Software Quality Analyst
positions.description:
Verified with engineers that new GraphQL queries were valid by analyzing their values using Bruno and Dbeaver.

Manipulated test data through SQL commands in DBeaver to make user data conform to each test case, and collected results on TFS and Confluence.

Created SQL queries to run on database tools such as DBeaver and SQL Management Studio to query for values

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Co-directed frontend migration epic for Request Portal Experience from Webskin to MUI with 4 engineers over 4 biweekly sprints using AGILE project management through JIRA

Contributed over 3,300 lines across 6 repositories using OverReact (React-Redux) with 90% unit test coverage.

Implemented frustration analytics used in real-time to enhance customer experience and reduce abandonment rate.
positions.insights: Skills: Back-End Web Development · Front-End Development · Dart · React.js · Redux
